column1: # Examples in the specification that the schema rejects because the text and
# the schema disagree, not because the example is wrong. Each needs a decision
# from the Technical Committee rather than an edit, so it is listed here and
# the check still fails on any new finding.
#   first line   text that appears in the offending document, to identify it
#   finding      text that appears in the finding being excused

column4: Included files: Chapter 2 says <header> is OPTIONAL in an included file, but the schema requires it. This example also places <style> directly under <xmile>, which 1.2 no longer allows anywhere but in views.
